dataset.identity: ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge training dataset; train_data.csv inside backend/ml_data/train_data.zip

evidence_assessment.conclusion: The meaning of -30 remains unresolved. ESA source documentation confirms log10 risk semantics, but does not define -30. The archive has no explicit censor/missing/below-limit indicator, and the project does not transform or specially handle -30.

experiment: ORION Phase 11.5 ESA target semantics and floor-value investigation

future_modeling_implications_without_rec.censored_regression: A censored-target method would require an authoritative statement that -30 encodes a lower limit/censoring, plus the censoring threshold and likelihood semantics; none was found.
future_modeling_implications_without_rec.classification_or_ranking: High/low labels can reproduce the documented challenge split at log10 risk -6, but whether the -30 mass should count as observed exact values or censored negatives affects interpretation and calibration. Ranking/classification would still predict challenge labels, not Pc.
future_modeling_implications_without_rec.literal_regression: Treating -30 as an ordinary numeric value is consistent with the current parser but would be scientifically justified only if it is a literal target value or the modeling objective intentionally reproduces the encoded challenge labels.
future_modeling_implications_without_rec.next_evidence_needed: Obtain an authoritative ESA explanation or original target-generation/scoring convention for -30, including whether it is a numeric clipping boundary, why that bound was chosen, and treatment of invalid/zero estimates.

limitations: The data scan establishes the distribution of encoded values, not how the data producer generated -30.
Official ESA pages explain the risk scale and challenge task but provide no -30-specific rule.
No original source-code implementation or detailed numerical convention for ESA risk generation was available locally.
ESA risk is a historical challenge target and must not be interpreted as Foster Pc or a calibrated probability.

reproducibility.split_protocol: same sorted mission IDs / random.Random(42) 70/15/15 floor/floor/remainder grouping used in Phase 11.2B

sentinel_and_missingness_assessment.code_handling: Training parser maps blank or non-finite risk to unavailable (None); if selected final target is unavailable, event target is skipped. It does not treat -30 specially.
sentinel_and_missingness_assessment.interpretation: Frequency at -30 alone cannot distinguish a valid exact log10 value from a floor, censoring boundary, or sentinel. Repository metadata repeats observed minimum -30 but does not define its semantics.

target_definition.model_target: risk from final/latest CDM row per event; final row selected by minimum time_to_tca with last file occurrence resolving ties
target_definition.official_documentation: ESA describes risk as a self-computed value at each CDM epoch in base-10 log; challenge asks prediction of final/last-CDM risk. This documents log10 semantics but does not define the special meaning of -30.

official_source_references.finding: The risk column is a self-computed value at each CDM epoch [base 10 log]; final risk is the value in the last CDM row. The page separately defines max_risk_estimate as a maximum collision probability obtained by scaling combined covariance. It does not state that -30 is a floor, censoring code, or sentinel.
The challenge predicts final risk, described as the risk in the last available CDM; no -30 floor/censoring convention is stated.
The challenge scoring page defines high-risk event threshold as risk >= 10^-6 and uses continuous-risk scoring; it does not document the semantics of the dataset value -30.

target_definition.training_transform: CSV cell is parsed as finite float; no logarithm, clipping, floor conversion, or other numeric transformation is applied by ORION. Final-row value is repeated as y for each pre-final feature row; evaluation scores one selected row per event.

target_value_distributions.raw_risk_cells_valid_time_only_scope: raw_risk_cells_all_valid_time_CDMs and raw_risk_cell_* validity counts below are scoped to rows with parseable nonnegative time_to_tca, matching the model reader
